sql: WITH s AS (SELECT o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28' AS in_window, i.seller_id, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders.orders o JOIN orders.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-04-30' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04' AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT round(max(n) FILTER (WHERE in_window) / sum(n) FILTER (WHERE in_window), 4) AS value, round(max(n) FILTER (WHERE NOT in_window) / sum(n) FILTER (WHERE NOT in_window), 4) AS baseline FROM s
